sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_fix_3ca4a0ecdbc97f001aa2dd3b5e96195b
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_fix"><sys_script_fix action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><before>false</before><description>Run this script to migrate KT Problem Analysis records to V2 (Problem Task records).</description><name>Advanced Problem Management V2 Migration</name><record_for_rollback>false</record_for_rollback><script><![CDATA[gs.info('K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: Start migration');
//Check that V1 and V2 Problem Analysis Tables Exist
if (gs.tableExists("kt_problem_analysis") && gs.tableExists("x_ket_apm_problem_analysis")) {
	var pa_v1 = new GlideRecord("kt_problem_analysis");
	pa_v1.addEncodedQuery("parentISNOTEMPTY");
	pa_v1.addQuery("parent.sys_class_name","problem");
	pa_v1.query();
	while (pa_v1.next()) {
		//Migrate to V2 APM if a V2 problem analysis task does not already exist
		if (no_apm_v2(pa_v1.parent)) {
			gs.info("K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: Problem record " + pa_v1.parent.number.toString());
			xfer_problem_analysis(pa_v1);
		}
		else {
			gs.info('K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: ' + pa_v1.parent.number + ' migration skipped. APM V2 Problem Task already exists');
		}
	}
}
else {
	if (!gs.tableExists("kt_problem_analysis")) {
		gs.info("K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: V1 Problem Analysis is not present. Migration not required.");
	}
	else {
		gs.info("K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: V2 Problem Analysis is not present. Migration not required.");
	}
}
gs.info('K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: End migration');

// Check for whether V2 Problem Analysis record already exists
function no_apm_v2(parent) {
	var result = true;
	var apm_pa = new GlideRecord("x_ket_apm_problem_analysis");
	apm_pa.addQuery("problem", parent);
	apm_pa.query();
	if (apm_pa.next()) {
		result = false;
	}
	return result;
}

function xfer_problem_analysis(pa) {
	var pa_v2 = new GlideRecord("x_ket_apm_problem_analysis");
	pa_v2.initialize();
	pa_v2.problem = pa.parent;
	pa_v2.problem_object = pa.problem_object;
	pa_v2.problem_deviation = pa.problem_deviation;
	var pa_v2_sysid = pa_v2.insert();

	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_01_what_object", "A1. What Object");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_02_what_deviation", "A2. What Deviation");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_03_where_geographically", "B1. Where Geographically");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_04_where_object", "B2. Where On The Object");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_05_when_first", "C1. When First");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_06_when_since", "C2. When Since");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_07_when_lifecycle", "C3. When In The Lifecycle");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_08_extent_objects", "D1. Number of Objects and Trend");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_10_extent_deviations", "D2. Size of Deviations and Trend");
	migrate_problem_analysis_details(pa.sys_id, pa_v2_sysid, "kt_11_extent_trend", "D3. Deviations per Object and Trend");
}

function migrate_problem_analysis_details(from_pa, to_pa, pa_detail, pa_type) {
	var v2_objects = new GlideRecord ("x_ket_apm_is_and_is_not");
	v2_objects.initialize();
	v2_objects.parent = to_pa;
	v2_objects.type = pa_type;
	var v1_what_object = new GlideRecord(pa_detail);
	v1_what_object.addQuery("problem_analysis",from_pa);
	v1_what_object.query();
	while (v1_what_object.next()) {
		v2_objects.is = v1_what_object.is;
		v2_objects.is_not = v1_what_object.is_not;
		v2_objects.changes = '';
		v2_objects.distinctions = '';
		//Get Distinctions and Changes
		var dist_chg = new GlideRecord("kt_distinctions_changes");
		dist_chg.addQuery("problem_area.sys_id",v1_what_object.sys_id.toString());
		dist_chg.query();
		if (dist_chg.next()) {
			v2_objects.changes = dist_chg.change;
			v2_objects.distinctions = dist_chg.distinction;
		}
		v2_objects.insert();
		gs.info("K-T APM V1 to V2 Migration: " + v2_sysid + " - is: " + v2_objects.is + " - is not: " + v2_objects.is_not + " - changes: " + v2_objects.changes + " - distinctions: " + v2_objects.distinctions);
	}
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_fix</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jbochnak</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-04-22 23:48:08</sys_created_on><sys_id>3ca4a0ecdbc97f001aa2dd3b5e96195b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>12</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Advanced Problem Management V2 Migration</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Advanced Problem Management (RCA)" source="x_ket_apm">a2cf556cdbfbef0070d7d5f0cf9619ad</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Advanced Problem Management (RCA)">a2cf556cdbfbef0070d7d5f0cf9619ad</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fix_3ca4a0ecdbc97f001aa2dd3b5e96195b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbochnak</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2019-04-24 20:55:02</sys_updated_on><unloadable>false</unloadable></sys_script_fix></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_ket_apm_problem_analysis</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Initialize KT Problem Analysis</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {

    //	Because this is a "display" rule, we must not create new related
    //	records every time we view the record, so first check to see if one exists
    var isIsNotGr = new GlideRecordSecure("x_ket_apm_is_and_is_not");
    isIsNotGr.addQuery("parent", current.sys_id);
    isIsNotGr.query();
    if (isIsNotGr.next()) {
        return; //	We already have related records associated, so exit early
    }

    //	Build list of related "Step 1" records
    insertColumnType("A1. What Object");
    insertColumnType("A2. What Deviation");
    insertColumnType("B1. Where Geographically");
    insertColumnType("B2. Where On The Object");
    insertColumnType("C1. When First");
    insertColumnType("C2. When Since");
    insertColumnType("C3. When In The Lifecycle");
    insertColumnType("D1. Number of Objects and Trend");
    insertColumnType("D2. Size of Deviations and Trend");
    insertColumnType("D3. Deviations per Object and Trend");

})(current, previous);

//	Insert related record and attach to parent Incident Analysis
function insertColumnType(columnName) {
    var insertGr = new GlideRecordSecure("x_ket_apm_is_and_is_not");
    insertGr.initialize();
    insertGr.type = columnName;
    insertGr.parent = current.sys_id;
    insertGr.insert();
}]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>jbochnak</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2019-02-26 00:59:50</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>a80cd4aadbf3230070d7d5f0cf96194d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Initialize KT Problem Analysis</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Advanced Problem Management (RCA)" source="x_ket_apm">a2cf556cdbfbef0070d7d5f0cf9619ad</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Advanced Problem Management (RCA)">a2cf556cdbfbef0070d7d5f0cf9619ad</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_a80cd4aadbf3230070d7d5f0cf96194d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>jbochnak</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-01-31 21:09:06</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before_display</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=a80cd4aadbf3230070d7d5f0cf96194d"/></record_update>
